ValidationRule.description: Company field is Mandatory if "Company Not Yet Registered" is not checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', OR(AND(ISBLANK(Company) , NOT(Not_Registered__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Company)) , Not_Registered__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a Company Name OR Check Not Registered, but not both.
